description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

**The Opportunity**

The myFICO Scores B2C Software Engineering team is hiring an Applied AI engineer to own the quality, safety, and performance of our AI-powered consumer features. As myFICO expands its AI-powered product features, this role combines Python and Java backend engineering with hands-on LLM experience to own how our assistants are prompted, evaluated, guarded, and improved. You will treat AI quality as something we measure and build the tooling our analysts and QA engineers rely on.

**What You’ll Contribute**

  

* Own the system prompts, tool descriptions, and evaluation prompts behind Personalized Credit Insights and the AI chat assistant, improving them using production evidence.
* Build and grow the evaluation framework: turn production failures into test cases, run regression suites before every prompt or model change, and report results the business can trust.
* Measure and improve LLM-based evaluator reliability by comparing against human-labeled data and tracking precision, recall, and agreement over time.
* Design, tune, and monitor guardrails, including input and output classifiers, PII redaction, prompt-injection defenses, and financial-advice compliance rules defined with Legal and Compliance.
* Lead model upgrades by re-running evaluations, comparing quality, cost, and latency, and shipping safely through A/B tests.
* Reduce cost and latency with prompt caching, model routing, and context management.
* Build tools for Conversation Analysts and QA engineers, such as transcript viewers, labeling workflows, and dashboards.
* Partner with Analytics, Legal, and Compliance on fairness and bias evaluation of AI outputs.
* Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, with the judgment to review and refine their output.

**What We’re Seeking**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated professional software engineering experience, strong Python, and the ability to read and contribute to Java (Spring Boot) microservices.
* Proven experience building and operating LLM-powered applications in production, including prompt design, tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming.
* Demonstrated experience building evaluations for LLM systems: test sets, regression suites, and LLM-as-judge approaches, including measuring evaluator quality against human labels.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock or a comparable managed LLM platform, and AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and DynamoDB.
* Proficient SQL and comfort analyzing production data in a data warehouse such as Amazon Redshift.
* Production ownership, including code review, CI/CD, release management, and on-call support, within Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain evaluation results and tradeoffs to product, legal, and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with guardrail tooling, LLM security testing, RAG and retrieval evaluation, fairness and bias evaluation, model migrations, observability tools such as Datadog, BI tools such as Tableau, or regulated domains (FCRA, ECOA, UDAAP, CFPB guidance) is a plus.

* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
* The targeted base pay range for this role is: $105,000 to $165,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers

You will bridge the gap between complex business logic and machine intelligence, ensuring high-quality, safe, and deterministic AI behaviors.

**What You Will Do:**

**Prompt Architecture & Tuning**

* **Design Advanced Prompts:** Architect, version, and refine highly effective system, contextual, and dynamic prompts using advanced techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Tree-of-Thoughts, ReAct, Few-Shot learning).
* **Mitigate Risks:** Minimize model hallucinations, jailbreaking, and prompt injections through programmatic guardrails and robust adversarial prompting strategies.
* **Model Agnostic Tuning:** Adapt, benchmark, and fine-tune prompt structures across diverse open-source and proprietary frontier models.

**Agentic Workflows & RAG Systems**

* **Build AI Agents:** Design and orchestrate multi-agent systems and multi-step reasoning workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain.
* **Optimize RAG Pipelines:** Integrate and fine-tune Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures, managing semantic search, chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database queries.
* **Tool Execution:** Implement precise function-calling and tool-use prompts enabling LLMs to interact reliably with external APIs, databases, and legacy codebases.

**Testing, Evaluation & Observability**

* Build automated testing suites using RAGAS and **Evals** frameworks to assess RAG accuracy and enable continuous validation and benchmarking of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation outputs across datasets and Models .

* **Agent Testing:** Build automated regression testing suites and CI/CD pipelines to validate prompt stability, agent trajectory correctness, and tool-calling accuracy.
* **Implement LLM Observability:** Set up production monitoring and observability systems using platforms like Azure Application insights, Microsoft Foundry.
* **Monitor Metrics:** Track, analyze, and optimize production runtime metrics including semantic drift, token usage, cost efficiencies, and end-to-end latency.

**Collaboration & Continuous Innovation**

* **Technology Scouting:** Keep pace with rapid weekly advancements in LLM capabilities, evaluation frameworks, and orchestration libraries to sustain a competitive edge.

* Production Programming: High proficiency in Python or TypeScript for constructing backend AI logic, processing asynchronous data streams, and handling API integrations.
* Orchestration Frameworks: Hands-on experience building apps using LangChain, LangGraph, native SDKs.
* Vector Infrastructure: Solid experience working with vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, AWS Open Search) and hybrid search retrieval methods.
* Data & ML Fundamentals: Strong capabilities in data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), data cleaning, token handling, and foundational understanding of NLP transformers.

**Top Candidates Will Have**

* **AI Observability Stacks:** Prior implementation of Application Insights, OpenLLMetry, or custom evaluation/guardrail layers.
* **Machine Learning Systems:** Knowledge of deep learning architectures, fine-tuning frameworks (QLoRA, PEFT), and platforms like Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience deploying containerized AI microservices using Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Linguistics, Mathematics, or a highly technical discipline.
* **Experience:** 2+ years of dedicated professional experience developing production software integrated with GenAI/LLM pipelines.
* **Track Record:** Proven portfolio demonstrating successfully deployed RAG systems or operational AI agents in commercial environments.
